Setp.GitCfgFail.Body: {0} 应用内下载仍然走加速，只有命令行里的 git 拉取还是直连。
{0} In-app downloads are still accelerated; only git fetches in a terminal stay direct.

The global git rules could not be removed
Setp.GitCfgRemoveFail.Body: {0} 应用内已恢复直连，但终端里的 git 仍会被这条规则带去加速。
{0} In-app requests are direct again, but git in a terminal is still routed through the relay by that rule.

Setp.AccelOff.Title: GitHub 加速服务已关闭
GitHub acceleration is off
Setp.AccelOn.Body: 应用内请求已走中转；全局 git 配置也写好了，终端与酒馆更新里的 GitHub 拉取同样加速。
In-app requests go through the relay; the global git config is written too, so GitHub fetches from a terminal and from tavern updates are accelerated as well.
Setp.AccelOff.Body: 应用内请求恢复直连，全局 git 配置里的加速规则也已移除。
In-app requests are direct again and the acceleration rule was removed from the global git config.

Setp.Conn.Title: GitHub 连通性测试
GitHub connectivity test
Setp.Conn.Subtitle: 真的去访问网页、API、Raw，再把仓库完整拉一份下来；数字是这次实测出来的。
It really opens the website, the API, and a raw file, then clones the whole repository; the numbers come from this run.
Setp.Conn.Description: {0}。四项并发进行；克隆会真拉完整仓库（约 100 MB）到临时目录，拉取时显示进度与速度，测完自动删除；超过 {1} 秒还没拉完就按超时算。

{0}. The four run in parallel; the clone really pulls the full repository (about 100 MB) into a temp folder, showing progress and speed, and deletes it afterwards; anything still running after {1} seconds counts as a timeout.
Setp.Conn.ApiFail: API 不通：版本列表只能用缓存。
The API is unreachable: the release list can only come from cache.
Setp.Conn.RawFail: Raw 不通：blob 转 raw 的下载会失败。
Raw files are unreachable: downloads that convert blob to raw will fail.
Setp.Conn.CloneFail: 克隆失败：安装与更新内置实例都会受影响。
Clone failed: installing and updating the built-in instance are both affected.
Setp.Conn.WebsiteFail: 官网打不开：仓库页、文档跳转都不通。
The website will not open: repository and documentation links are unreachable.

Setp.Reset.Body: 所有偏好回到首次启动时的状态，包括环境来源、代理与下载通道。
Every preference returns to its first-run state, including the environment source, proxy, and download channel.
Setp.Reset.Note: 已经安装的 Git / Node.js / PM2 不会被删除，只是设置不再指向它们。路径类选项会重置为默认目录。
Installed Git / Node.js / PM2 are not deleted; the settings simply stop pointing at them. Path options reset to the default folders.
